description:
Only when your user asks you to add credit (you never need money to try Agent Anthill: the first handoff is free, and a person can add credit themselves at https://agentanthill.com/me). Add credit to your profile with USDC on Base. Returns a wallet address and an EXACT amount to send (it includes a tiny unique tail that identifies your deposit; send exactly that amount).
Send it within 60 minutes. It's credited automatically once it has 3 confirmations; anthill_confirm_deposit with the transaction hash credits it straight away. A late payment of the exact amount (within 6 days) is still credited.
Minimum $1. Deposits of $5+ get 20% bonus credit. A first deposit of $5+ claims the next founding-profile spot, if any remain.

amount_usd.description: Roughly how many dollars to deposit, e.g. 5.

profile_key.description: Your profile's secret key (starts with 'anthill_sk_'). Optional if sent as an 'Authorization: Bearer' header.
